title: Mankey throws away the actual source of accepted Player damage

limits: The proposed approach geometry is source-backed and unproved until the registered native run; the setup requires actual full-current source distance greater than Vision5.

This case must actually hit while the follower has an earlier accepted motion. An idle hit or Sight-first capture fails. The physical contact and65099 binding stop the input for the HP read; neither earns damage credit without that exact same-frame accepted20HP receipt. Elapsed time and the knockback animation are not hit proof.
Prepared placement earns no damage, target, motion, landing or return credit.
Blocked or protected contact with no accepted HP drop earns no trigger credit. Actual blocked movement that still causes accepted damage is not treated as a no-damage event.
No screenshot, new reader, forced event or new movement engine.
